name: Frontend Development
description: Master modern client-side web development covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, DOM manipulation, APIs, and React application architecture.

name: Backend Development
description: Build robust server-side applications and APIs using Node.js, Express, async programming, security best practices, and integration strategies.

name: DevOps & Cloud
description: Learn Linux environments, Git workflows, cloud infrastructure on AWS, Docker containerization, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

name: Relational Databases
description: Master relational database architecture, schema design, advanced SQL queries, normalization, indexing, ACID transactions, and performance tuning.

name: AI & Machine Learning
description: Understand core AI/ML principles, supervised/unsupervised learning with Python, statistical modeling, neural networks, LLMs, and RAG architectures.

name: Data Analytics
description: Transform raw business data into actionable insights using analytics fundamentals, advanced Microsoft Excel modeling, and Power BI dashboards.
